name: Yuumi's Mother
source:
She is the mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c21994]Yuumi[/url].

She lost her husband several years ago when Yuumi was a kid. Because of financial problems, she decided to move away with her daughter from the city for finding a less expensive house.

[spoiler]Several years after the beginning of the game, she find another lover and remarried with him. She is now pregnant and is waiting for the arrival of a little girl.[/spoiler]
translation:
She is the mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c21994]Yuumi[/url].

She lost her husband several years ago when Yuumi was a kid. Because of financial problems, she decided to move away with her daughter from the city for finding a less expensive house.

[spoiler]Several years after the beginning of the game, she find another lover and remarried with him. She is now pregnant and is waiting for the arrival of a little girl.[/spoiler]
